content.title: Saba Capital Management Reduces Stake in Eaton Vance CA Muni Income Trust
content.summary: On October 15, 2024, Saba Capital Management, L.P. (Trades, Portfolio), a prominent investment firm, executed a reduction in its holdings of Eaton Vance CA Muni Income Trust (CEV).  This move reflects a strategic adjustment in Saba Capital's portfolio, where CEV now represents a 0.13% position, marking a significant shift in the firm's investment strategy.  Located at 405 Lexington Avenue, New York, Saba Capital Management is renowned for its sharp focus on value investing, particularly in distressed assets.

content.title: SIT Investment Associates Inc Acquires Shares in Eaton Vance CA Muni Income Trust
content.summary: On October 7, 2024, SIT Investment Associates Inc made a significant addition to its portfolio by acquiring 857,660 shares of Eaton Vance CA Muni Income Trust (CEV).  Founded in 1981 by Eugene C. Sit, SIT Investment Associates Inc started with a modest $1 million capital and has grown significantly over the decades.  With a team of 36 investment professionals, SIT Investment Associates employs a mix of quantitative and fundamental analysis across various sectors, with a strong focus on financial services and technology.
